copy.heading: Why are we going there?
copy.instructions: For each holiday, circle the real reason you suggested it.

blocks.text: 1. "A lovely family resort in Spain, great kids' club."

items: c. Six padel courts and a nightly league

blocks.text: 2. "Let's do a city break in Madrid."

items: c. A padel tournament the same weekend

blocks.text: 3. "How about a weekend at your mum and dad's?"

items: c. There's a new club twenty minutes from their house
c. You have just found a court in Truro

blocks.text: If you circled c for every one, please hand the booking over to Lauren.
